ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (22) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

«Лже-христы и лже-пророки» (lzhe-khristy i lzhe-proroki) is kept as 'false Christs and false prophets', and «отец небесный» (otets nebesny) as lowercase 'the heavenly father', following the print. Attributions are printed as Tolstoy gives them: «По Карлейлю» (po Karleylyu) is 'After Carlyle', not the website's 'Thomas Carlyle'; the closing thought keeps Tolstoy's italics.
